title: Evaluate Apple iCloud Drive support
context: Determine whether iCloud Drive can be a practical Linux upload target.

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm whether rclone has a usable iCloud Drive backend.
Test upload, listing, checksum, and download if a supported path exists.
Record the operational cost of a macOS host, if required.
Decide: supported, manual web upload, or not supported.
If supported, add a dedicated provider issue.
